Denzel Curry & Kenneth Blume's ii has the highest user score of any 2026 rap album with 10K+ ratings on albumoftheyear.org: 84 from 13,332+ ratings, as of Oct 15, 2026. 🔥

Kenneth Blume is the producer formerly known as Kenny Beats. ii came out Aug 21 on Loma Vista Recordings, runs nine tracks and about 24 minutes, and is the sequel to their 2020 collaboration UNLOCKED (followed by UNLOCKED 1.5 in 2021). Guests: Yebba on lead single "DIFFERENCE", JPEGMAFIA on "EVIL GRIN" and Westside Gunn on "CROWN". A vinyl edition follows Dec 4.

For comparison, J. Cole's The Fall-Off scores 80 (17,350 ratings) and Vince Staples's Cry Baby scores 80 (11,859 ratings). On Spotify, "DIFFERENCE" leads ii with 2.98M streams, then "GONE FISHING" (2.65M), "EVIL GRIN" (2.02M) and "CROWN" (1.54M). Denzel Curry has 7.3M monthly listeners, Kenny Beats 3.6M.

Is ii your rap album of 2026? Tell us what beats it. 👇
